rules.title: Annual Rent Increase for 3/1/26 - 2/28/27 Announced (San Francisco Rent Board annual allowable increase)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent. The prior period (3/1/25 to 2/28/26) allowed 1.4%.
rules.citation: Annual Rent Increase for 3/1/26 - 2/28/27 Announced, SF Rent Board
rules.status_basis: Announced January 14, 2026; effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Applies to rent-controlled units in San Francisco.

rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
